cards.example_en: A university lecturer described college life in the assembly hall.
cards.example_zh: 一位大学讲师在礼堂里介绍了大学生活。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：制造者
cards.example_en: The violin maker let us watch him shape a new instrument.
cards.example_zh: 小提琴制造者让我们看他制作一件新乐器。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：运动员；选手
cards.example_en: The youngest player scored the winning goal.
cards.example_zh: 最年轻的选手打进了制胜一球。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：排外的
cards.example_en: Membership at that exclusive club costs more than my bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 那个排外俱乐部的会费比我的自行车还贵。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：逐渐地
中考/CEFR 常用词：有希望地
cards.example_en: She looked hopefully at the score on the screen.
cards.example_zh: 她满怀希望地看着屏幕上的分数。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：意大利
cards.example_en: We ate lemon ice cream on a warm evening in Italy.
cards.example_zh: 我们在意大利一个暖和的晚上吃了柠檬冰淇淋。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：强烈地
cards.example_en: The teacher strongly advised us to review tonight.
cards.example_zh: 老师强烈建议我们今晚复习。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：协议；同意
cards.example_en: Both teams signed an agreement before the friendly match.
cards.example_zh: 两支队伍在友谊赛开始前签了一份协议。

cards.example_en: You don't need much equipment to go running.
cards.example_zh: 您不需要太多设备就可以跑步。

cards.example_en: She won first prize in the speech competition.
cards.example_zh: 她在竞赛中获得一等奖。

cards.example_en: The coach's evaluation praised our passing but not our shooting.
cards.example_zh: 教练的评估表扬了传球，却没表扬射门。

cards.example_en: Your participation made the charity concert a success.
cards.example_zh: 你参加了慈善音乐会，演出因此获得了成功。
